Positioned in center with smaller subhead below: 'Enhanced first goalscorer odds. Real Madrid meets Bayern Munich tonight.' in Inter font, dark purple text. Orange #FF6B2F accent elements frame the text area. Prominent white 'JOIN NOW' button with orange border at bottom center. Small CB logo in bottom-right corner in dark purple. Champions League themed with subtle football iconography, premium overlay design with strong color contrast and clear text hierarchy.
